# Support Matrix

BoardReadyOps compatibility is defined in `docs/compatibility.yaml` and rendered here for humans.

## KiCad

Minimum supported KiCad: **9.0**. Recommended KiCad line: **10.x**.

| Runtime | Version | Status | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| KiCad | 9.0 | Supported | Variants are partially supported. |
| KiCad | 9.1 | Supported |  |
| KiCad | 10.0 | Supported | Full variant + native IPC API support. |
| KiCad | 10.1 | Supported | Full variant + native IPC API support. |
| KiCad | 10.x | Recommended | Full variant + native IPC API support. |

## Node.js

Minimum supported Node.js major: **22**.

| Runtime | Version | Status | Tested latest |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Node.js | 22 | Minimum supported runtime | 22.22.3 |
| Node.js | 24 | Supported LTS runtime | 24.16.0 |

## Drift Detection

The scheduled `compatibility-drift` workflow compares this matrix with the Node.js release index and KiCad GitLab tags. It opens a GitHub issue when a new supported runtime line needs review.
